PM Modi Addresses Youth at Red Fort Event

Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed students at an event following a protest by the CJP. This was his first public appearance among students after the protest. During the event, held at the Red Fort, the Prime Minister also participated in a flag-hoisting ceremony where 'Vande Mataram' was recited for the first time. He is scheduled to interact with 'Gen-Z' from the Red Fort, and the government is collecting data on youth-focused initiatives.
